trait.name: Legendary Resistance (4/Day)
entries: If the emissary fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

action.name: Lashing Maw (Reach 15 ft.)
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 14} to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. {@h}20 ({@damage 2d12 + 7}) piercing damage plus 13 ({@damage 3d8}) psychic damage.

action.name: Psychic Orb
entries: {@atk rs} {@hit 15} to hit, range 120 ft., one creature. {@h}27 ({@damage 5d10}) psychic damage.

action.name: Unearthly Bile {@recharge 5}
entries: 30-foot-radius sphere within 120 feet. {@dc 23} Dexterity save, taking 55 ({@damage 10d10}) acid damage and 55 ({@damage 10d10}) necrotic damage on a failed save, or half on a success.

legendary.name: Warp Space (2 Actions)
entries: Up to three creatures within 60 feet must make a {@dc 23} Wisdom save or take 14 ({@damage 4d6}) psychic damage and be teleported to an unoccupied space within 60 feet.

legendary.name: Mind Cloud (3 Actions)
entries: Each enemy within 30 feet must make a {@dc 23} Wisdom save or take 33 ({@damage 6d10}) psychic damage and be {@condition incapacitated} until the end of its next turn.
